text: {"memo": "McDonald’s Corporation delivered a solid finish to fiscal year 2024, posting revenue of roughly $30.0\u202fbillion, net income of $8.2\u202fbillion and diluted EPS of $3.55. Operating margin held near 30\u202fpercent, while free cash flow improved to about $5.5\u202fbillion, supporting continued share buybacks and dividend growth. Same\u2011store sales rose 4.5\u202fpercent, a modest pace after the robust 5.5\u202fpercent gain in FY\u202f2023, when revenue was $28.4\u202fbillion, net income $7.6\u202fbillion, EPS $3.30 and free cash flow $5.0\u202fbillion. The prior year, FY\u202f2022, showed revenue of $28.0\u202fbillion, net income $7.1\u202fbillion, EPS $2.95 and free cash flow $4.5\u202fbillion, with same\u2011store sales up 8.0\u202fpercent. Looking back further, FY\u202f2021 generated $26.0\u202fbillion in revenue, $5.5\u202fbillion in net income, EPS $2.30 and free cash flow $3.5\u202fbillion, and same\u2011store sales growth of about 9.0\u202fpercent. Margins have remained consistently strong, with operating margins hovering around 30\u202fpercent and net margins near 27\u202fpercent across the period. The company’s cash generation and disciplined capital allocation continue to underpin its defensive franchise appeal, though elevated valuation levels suggest investors should weigh upside potential against current price."}
